summary: Implements the entire `ai-metrics` CLI suite (42 Command.make nodes across ingest, sources, config, privacy, install, forwarder, otlp, label, benchmark, report, mirror, retention, archive) in one file: ~45 flag definitions, ~25 per-program option schema classes, config/secret resolution, time-window parsing, DuckDB/OTLP layer orchestration, ssh/rsync process execution, and all text/JSON rendering, delegating domain logic to @beep/repo-ai-metrics.

concerns.name: Flag definitions
concerns.description: ~45 module-level Flag constants including near-duplicates with divergent defaults (maxFilesFlag 200 vs timerMaxFilesFlag 5, maxSnapshotExportsFlag 0 vs forwarderRunMaxSnapshotExportsFlag 5, parquetExportModeFlag snapshot vs timerParquetExportModeFlag none, and the deliberately inert forwarderRunRetentionEnforceCompatFlag).

concerns.name: Error union + program runner + JSON codecs
concerns.description: Cross-cutting wiring: the 13-member tagged error union, the asVoid program adapter, and shared JSON encode helpers used by every subcommand.

concerns.name: ConfigProvider/env and secret-ref resolution guards
concerns.description: Effect ConfigProvider reads (HOME, BEEP_AI_METRICS_HASH_SALT, BEEP_AI_METRICS_RAW_ARCHIVE_KEY[_SECRET_REF]) plus target-conditional require* guards with their S.Class option schemas.

concerns.name: Time-window and retention-selector parsing (pure domain)
concerns.description: ISO-or-epoch-millis parsing, 7-day default windows, retention selector construction and bounded/ordered window predicates, plus parseChecks CSV splitting.

concerns.name: Install workflow programs + renderers
concerns.description: Install input/spec/plan/doctor/apply/compose program logic, OTLP endpoint derivation, ServerObservabilityConfig construction, and their text renderers.

concerns.name: Ingest/sources/privacy/config-snapshot programs + FS walking
concerns.description: Transcript file reading, recursive .jsonl directory walk, source discovery, config snapshot, and privacy-check programs with inline rendering.

concerns.name: Forwarder + OTLP orchestration
concerns.description: Forwarder run with scoped DuckDb layer builds, optional OTLP export via layerNodeSdkServerTraces with Exit-based failure recovery, systemd timer plan rendering that re-embeds a CLI command line, and standalone OTLP export.

concerns.name: Benchmark/label/report DuckDB programs
concerns.description: Six near-identical programs that build an install spec, open a scoped DuckDb node layer, call one @beep/repo-ai-metrics operation, and render JSON-or-text.

concerns.name: P7 mirror workflow: process exec + manifest validation
concerns.description: Bun.spawnSync-based ssh/rsync execution with captured output, confirm-token gating, and sanitized-bundle contract validation (allowed file list, manifest schema/privacy/table checks, parquet inventory diff).

concerns.name: Retention + archive decrypt-drill programs
concerns.description: Retention list/delete/compact/enforce/restore-drill with confirm-token dry-run semantics, plus an archive drill embedding raw SQL against ai_metrics_raw_archive_objects and envelope decrypt/hash verification.

concerns.name: Command-tree wiring
concerns.description: 42 Command.make declarations (13 group hubs printing usage lines + 29 leaf commands) that destructure flags and delegate 1:1 to make*Program, ending in the exported aiMetricsCommand root.

concerns.name: Per-program option schema classes
concerns.description: ~20 S.Class option bags (Make*ProgramOptions) interleaved with their programs; LOC already counted inside the program concerns above, but they are a distinct schema-first modeling responsibility that should move with (or alongside) their programs.

proposedSplit.contents: Keep only the ~45 Flag definitions, the 42 Command.make declarations, and the exported aiMetricsCommand root; each leaf handler calls runAiMetricsProgram(make*Program(...)) imported from internal modules. Shrinks to roughly 1150-1250 LOC.

Cross-cutting data schemas: ParseWindowOptions, ParseRetentionSelectorOptions, RequireHashSalt*/RequireRawArchiveKey*Options, CapturedCommandResult, AiMetricsArchiveDrillRow, plus shared constants (localCollectorDataRoot, p7Mirror*/p7Retention* tokens, defaultP7Mirror* values) so internal modules never import each other for constants.

Absorb AiMetricsProgramError (the 13-member S.Union toTaggedUnion) and runAiMetricsProgram next to the existing AiMetricsCommandError/AiMetricsStatusExit, since the union is the command error boundary.

ConfigProvider-backed resolution: readOptionalConfigString/readOptionalRedactedConfigString, resolveHomeDir, resolveRepoRoot, resolveHashSalt(SecretRef), resolveRawArchiveKey(SecretRef), and the requireHashSalt*/requireRawArchiveKey*ForTarget guards. This earns the reserved config role because it is exactly runtime/config-provider backed settings.

Pure time-window/selector logic: parseEpochMillisOption, parseSinceEpochMillis, parseOptionalEpochMillis, parseWindow, parseRetentionSelector, hasRetentionWindow/hasBoundedRetentionMutationWindow/hasOrderedRetentionMutationWindow, parseChecks.

makeCommandInstallInput/Spec, p6aCollectorDataRoot, defaultServiceEndpoint, serverObservabilityConfigFor, the five install programs (preview/plan/doctor/apply/compose) with their Options classes, and renderInstallSpec/renderInstallPlan/renderInstallDoctor.
readInputFile, collectJsonlInputFiles, readPrivacyInput, and the ingest, sources-discover, config-snapshot, and privacy-check programs with their Options classes.

Forwarder run/timer and OTLP export programs plus helpers: forwarderRunResultWithOtlpExport, forwarderRunCommandToJson, forwarderOtlpExported/Failed, exportForwarderDerivedOtlp, makeForwarderRunProgram, makeForwarderTimerProgram, makeOtlpExportProgram.

DuckDB-backed benchmark case add/list, benchmark run/compare, label queue/add, and weekly report programs; extract the repeated scoped Layer.build(DuckDb.makeNodeLayer(...)) provide pattern into one local withDuckDb helper (or the shared one below).

runCapturedCommand, commandText, resolveMirrorBundleDir, readMirrorManifest, requireSafeMirrorManifest, isAllowedMirrorBundleFile, listMirrorBundleFiles, validateLocalMirrorBundle, and the mirror build/sync/status programs.
confirmRetentionMutation and the retention list/delete-compact/enforce/restore-drill programs plus makeArchiveDrillProgram with its inline SQL and AiMetricsArchiveDrillRow decode.

Package-internal helper `withDuckDb(databasePath)(effect)` wrapping Effect.scoped(Layer.build(DuckDb.makeNodeLayer(DuckDbConnectionOptions.make({databasePath})))) + Effect.provide — the pattern is repeated ~9 times in this file and verbatim in Research, Corpus, and AgentEffectiveness.

sharedCandidates.description: The Effect.scoped(Layer.build(DuckDb.makeNodeLayer(DuckDbConnectionOptions.make({databasePath})))).pipe(Effect.flatMap(ctx => eff.pipe(Effect.provide(ctx)))) idiom appears ~9 times here and verbatim in Research/internal/Catalog.ts:72, Corpus/Corpus.service.ts:369, AgentEffectiveness/internal/EvalScorer.ts:1185.
Bun.spawnSync wrapper capturing stdout/stderr/exitCode into a schema class with typed failure; Graphiti/internal/ProxyServices.ts:662 and bin-main.ts hand-roll the same spawnSync capture.
Generic ISO-timestamp-or-epoch-millis flag parsing with default 7-day windows; nothing AI-metrics-specific except error messages, useful to any command taking --since/--until.
ConfigProvider-based optional env reads returning Option (plain and Redacted); a generic pattern any command reading env-backed settings needs.
HOME-with-flag-override and cwd-with-flag-override path resolution; completely command-agnostic.
Two hand-rolled recursive FileSystem walks in this one file (one filtering .jsonl, one collecting relative paths); a shared walkFiles(root, predicate) in src/internal would delete both.

risks: Public facade/test surface: index.ts does `export * from ./AIMetrics.command.js` and test/ai-metrics-command.test.ts (1796 lines) imports aiMetricsCommand via @beep/repo-cli/commands/AIMetrics; the split must keep aiMetricsCommand exported from the facade and must NOT re-export internal/ role files (topology says deep role files are private).

$I identity churn: every S.Class/error uses $RepoCliId.create("commands/AIMetrics/AIMetrics.command") in its identifier; moving classes to new files changes their $I module path, which feeds the tracked deterministic P3 schema catalog (commit 5783560) — catalog regeneration and any ID/annotation-sensitive checks must be rerun.

Same-named flags with different defaults are a swap hazard: max-snapshot-exports (0 vs 5), max-files (200 vs 5), max-file-bytes (optional vs 8388608), parquet-mode (snapshot vs none), and retention-enforce (real flag on timer vs deliberate no-op compat flag on forwarder run); wiring the wrong constant silently changes behavior and the compat flag removal would break already-installed systemd timer units.

makeForwarderTimerProgram renders a literal CLI invocation (bin path packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/bin.ts plus flag names like --max-snapshot-exports/--parquet-mode) into systemd units; refactors must not rename flags or alter argument ordering or previously rendered/installed units diverge from what run accepts.

Import-cycle risk: localCollectorDataRoot, p7MirrorConfirmToken, p7RetentionConfirmToken, p7MirrorSchemaVersion are shared by install, forwarder, mirror, and retention clusters — hoist constants into AIMetrics.schemas.ts first or the internal modules will import each other; keep dependency direction internal/* -> (schemas|errors|config), command.ts -> internal/*.

Docgen/crispening gates are blocking for the tooling family: each new file needs its own $RepoCliId.create module id, @packageDocumentation/@since/@example JSDoc on exports, and `bun run beep yeet verify` (turbo check has a known phantom-fail cache race after out-of-band builds) plus docgen:local must pass.
